agencyName: Iowa Legislative Services Agency (Iowa Administrative Code, Chapter 481—403, Education, administered by DIAL's Electrical Examining Board)
authorityRationale: The codified chapter governing postsecondary electrical education program standards and continuing-education requirements (481—403), effective 5/22/24, published directly by Iowa's Legislative Services Agency at legis.iowa.gov. Contains the 18-hours-per-3-year-license continuing-education rule (403.201) and the postsecondary program hour minimums (403.102) cited in requiredEducation and continuingEducationRequirements.
reliabilityRationale: Primary codified regulatory text, same publisher and vintage as iowa-admin-code-481-401.
